noticias.titulo: Orthodox Cleric Wanted in Connection With International Forgery Scheme
noticias.resumo: A 44-year-old man was arrested during an undercover operation into an art forgery scheme in Athens, Greece, on Saturday, November 21, exposing an international network allegedly overseen by a Florida-based Orthodox…
noticias.trecho: A 44-year-old man was arrested during an undercover operation into an art forgery scheme in Athens, Greece, on Saturday, November 21, exposing an international network allegedly overseen by a Florida-based Orthodox priest. The arrest subsequently yielded the discovery of 35 forged paintings falsely attributed to prominent Greek and international artists, among other valuables. The man, who remains unidentified to the public, was arrested on his way to make a sale to an undercover cop who posed as a client online. He had six paintings that he was going to sell to the undercover agents for €5,150 ($5,613). The investigation began in early October, when an art specialist tipped off authorities after encountering an online listing of two paintings attributed to famous 20th-century Greek expressionist George Bouzianis with counterfeit certificates of authenticity for sale.

noticias.resumo: Local studio Estudio A-G has foregrounded a sculptural timber structural element while implementing bold colours for the renovation of a 1960s house in Mexico City. Originally built in 1962 by Jaime Ortiz Monasterio…
noticias.trecho: Local studio Estudio A-G has foregrounded a sculptural timber structural element while implementing bold colours for the renovation of a 1960s house in Mexico City. Originally built in 1962 by Jaime Ortiz Monasterio, Casa Magnolia is located in the residential neighbourhood of San Ángel. Monasterio designed the home as a domestic library for his brother, who was an avid reader and book collector. Over the decades, the house was renovated multiple times, obscuring the home's original character. In 2025, Andrés Gutiérrez, head of Estudio A-G , was commissioned to reinterpret the interior of the 275-square-metre residence for new inhabitants, preserving the architectural qualities that made the original design unique. noticias.resumo: new images reveal ZHA’s royal theater in rabat   Zaha Hadid Architects (ZHA) has released new photographs of the Théâtre Royal de Rabat in Morocco , revealing the completed architecture of its first realized project in…
noticias.trecho: new images reveal ZHA’s royal theater in rabat   Zaha Hadid Architects (ZHA) has released new photographs of the Théâtre Royal de Rabat in Morocco , revealing the completed architecture of its first realized project in Africa. Captured by Hufton + Crow , the images trace the theater ‘s sweeping white exterior along the Bouregreg River before moving inside, where intersecting staircases lead toward a dramatically faceted auditorium.   Originally announced in 2010 as the Grand Théâtre de Rabat, the project has followed a long path to completion. Construction began in 2014, and the building received a ceremonial inauguration in October 2024. Its first public performance followed in April 2026, ten years after the death of Zaha Hadid.   Situated between the historic cities of Rabat and Salé, the theater forms part of a wider cultural development program initiated by King Mohammed VI. referencias.trecho: Na série Nos txôn (2019), capa da ZUM #31, a artista luso-cabo-verdiana Marta Pinto Machado apresenta autorretratos feitos pela mãe, Lúcia, que trabalhava como empregada doméstica em Paris nos anos 1980. As fotos e os textos – baseados em conversas da artista com a mãe – revelam o desejo de Lúcia de narrar a própria história, assumindo o controle da câmera e rejeitar o olhar colonial. Na série Projeto Família , o fotógrafo Motoyuki Daifu compartilha a intimidade de seu lar numa casa no subúrbio de Yokohama, no Japão, em instantâneos desconcertantes e bem-humorados apresentados pela curadora Yoko Sawada . A artista Inaê Moreira , vencedora da Bolsa ZUM/IMS 2025, viajou de Salvador ao Benin com a irmã, a cineasta Safira Moreira , para homenagear a espiritualidade afro-brasileira que une os dois lados do Atlântico, produzindo cianótipos acompanhados de textos poéticos. biblioteca.titulo: Inteligência artificial em perspectiva crítica: contribuições antropológicas e imaginários tecnológicos
biblioteca.resumo: A partir da grande popularidade da inteligência artificial (IA), especialmente das chamadas IAs generativas, o objetivo deste dossiê é trazer para discussão os possíveis significados da adoção da inteligência artificial…
biblioteca.trecho: A partir da grande popularidade da inteligência artificial (IA), especialmente das chamadas IAs generativas, o objetivo deste dossiê é trazer para discussão os possíveis significados da adoção da inteligência artificial na vida cotidiana, propondo sobretudo visões mais complexas de processos que estão longe de serem simplesmente bons ou ruins, prazerosos ou perigosos. Neste sentido, a partir de artigos que se caracterizam pela multidisciplinaridade e pela diversidade de abordagens, há a reflexão sobre os sentidos da IA em diferentes esferas da vida – educação, reconhecimento fácil, terapia, jornalismo -, bem como a importante indagação sobre os limites éticos de seu desenvolvimento e seu uso.

Claudia Kauffman, Nez Perce Tribe, and two reelected to the House – state Reps. Chris Stearns, Navajo Nation, and Debra Lekanoff, Tlingit and Aleut. Election results will be certified Dec. 3. bolhas.trecho: Kader Attia Unveils Curatorial Framework for 2027 Kochi-Muziris Biennale Algerian French artist and curator Kader Attia has revealed that the seventh Kochi-Muziris Biennale will center on “the relationship between dreams, memory, and repair.” Attia, who was appointed earlier this year to helm the forthcoming exhibition, is known for exploring the concept of repair in his own artistic practice. His curatorial vision foregrounds the unpredictability of dreams as a counter to the formulaic logic of AI, which is increasingly mediating the human condition. In a statement, Attia remarked, “Our subjectivity is fragmented, like the internet, . . . yet there we are tracked by the algorithm.
